stories.title: Break down the package units on the B/L cargo total
headline: One number,
now you can see what it holds
stories.purpose: Let an Outbound Documentation Agent see which package units make up the cargo total, listed as a count per type, without opening every container to read them off.
stories.why: Today the cargo total is one figure summing every container. To see what package units sit inside, an agent has to open each container one by one. A per-type breakdown shows what a shipment holds at a glance.
stories.improving: The cargo total lists one row per package unit, each with its own quantity, built from the container totals it already sums.
demo: A mixed-cargo B/L shows one row for each package type
A single-type B/L is shown in one row
The package quantities are added up, while keeping their original labels
Any cargo changes are reflected in the total
